下界合金外骨骼 ![外骨骼背面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/231362f137dbe6f572ada6dbdaccdc76ae81f76b.png) ![外骨骼正面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/024502b070f44d16f195d9c94e687c45dfeef775.png)
下界合金喷气背包 ![喷气背包背面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90261abbb323e0cc8835f088960c56f8bddbbbd4.png) ![喷气背包正面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/11233b577c4b6631a7fc51f4d3c71bbf1fa6d606.png)
合成配方 ![外骨骼配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d32b31956de0795b20f929e48beee42c8a4ad81a.png) ![喷气背包配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9f12d6467a4c39802743b9b15eae2592f0914ca.png) ![下界引擎配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3724c191fab9d8e20ef1756bf370345bba104525.png) ![飞轮配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/313a6f7dace304098177c1290764aee541c0767e.png)
本模组为FurtiTwo制作的[Create Stuff & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-stuff-additions)中的喷气背包和外骨骼添加了终局变体。 下界合金变体拥有与普通下界合金胸甲相同的属性。 ***运行本模组需要[CreateSA](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-stuff-additions)和[Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)作为前置。**
本模组可自由用于任何整合包中。 如有问题请在[CURSEFORGE评论区](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-netherite-additions/comments)或我的[DISCORD服务器](https://discord.gg/aYycXd9XeJ)反馈 本模组也已在[Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create-netherite-additions)上发布
